desc:
Ecom Swift LLC sets up WooCommerce shipping and accounting integrations: labels, live rates, bookkeeping, email lists, marketplace feeds and payment tools connected to your store so orders move without retyping.

## What are WooCommerce integrations?

A WooCommerce integration is a connection between your store and another tool, so data travels between them automatically. An order can create a shipping label, a customer can join an email list, a sale can appear in your accounting software and stock levels can match a warehouse system. Each connection removes one manual task and one chance for a typing error.

## Why disconnected tools cost time

A growing store often runs on copy and paste. Someone downloads orders each morning, types addresses into a courier site, enters totals into the books and updates a spreadsheet of stock. Every step takes minutes and every step can go wrong.

The cost shows up in small ways: a parcel sent to an old address, a customer who never receives a shipping update, an invoice entered twice, an item sold after it ran out. Connected tools turn those routines into a flow that runs on its own, and your time returns to buying, selling and serving customers.

## How good connections change the business

Accurate live shipping rates at checkout let shoppers see the real delivery cost before paying, which reduces surprises. Customer tags passed to your email tool let you send relevant messages to first-time buyers or repeat customers. Orders synced to accounting save hours at month end and reduce corrections.

Marketplace feeds widen reach, since your products can appear where shoppers already search. Stock sync prevents overselling across channels. These gains come from consistency and speed, and the size of the benefit depends on your order volume and how much manual work you do today.

## What a dependable integration setup includes

- Connections made inside your own accounts, so you keep control of every tool.
- A clear list of which data moves, in which direction and when.
- Shipping rates or label creation tied to your courier and your product weights.
- Order and customer data sent to your accounting software with correct tax handling.
- Customer tags or lists in your email tool, matched to purchase events.
- A product feed for one marketplace, built to that marketplace's published rules.
- Stock updates that run both ways when your system supports it.
- Automation flows in Zapier or Make for tasks that have no direct connection.
- An error notice, so a failed sync does not go unseen.

## How we work

We begin with a short call or message to list every tool you use and what you want each to do. Then we connect them one at a time inside your accounts, running test orders through every step. We check that the right order data reaches the right place and that errors raise an alert.

We finish by writing down where each piece of data goes. The Basic package connects one tool of your choice with a tested order. Standard links two or three tools and adds live shipping rates, email tags and accounting sync. Premium handles up to five tools, a feed to one marketplace, stock sync, an automation flow and a map of every step. Marketplace connections follow each marketplace's own rules, and acceptance of your listings is decided by the marketplace.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- List every manual task you repeat each week before choosing tools.
- Keep product weights, sizes and SKUs accurate, since many connections rely on them.
- Test one order from checkout to shipping label to accounting entry.
- Note which tool is the source of truth for stock.

**Avoid:**
- Connecting two tools that both try to update the same field.
- Sharing one login between several people and tools.
- Switching on every sync option at once without testing.
- Forgetting that outside tools may have their own subscription costs paid to their makers.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store owner who spends part of every day moving order details between screens, a seller who wants live courier rates at checkout, and a business that needs its sales to reach its accountant without manual exports. It also suits sellers who want their products listed on a marketplace as well as their own shop.

## What we need from you

Tell us which tools you use or want to use, and give us access to them as a user or developer role where the tool allows it. We never ask for your password. We also need administrator access to your store, set up as a user for us, and the freedom to place a few test orders that you can cancel.
